```{python}
#| label: annotate
#| output: false

from sparknlp.base import DocumentAssembler, Pipeline, Finisher
from sparknlp.annotator import (
    SentenceDetector,
    Tokenizer,
    Normalizer,
    LemmatizerModel
)

if do_annotation:
    document = (
        DocumentAssembler()
        .setInputCol("paragraph")
        .setOutputCol("document")
    )

    sentence_detector = (
        SentenceDetector()
        .setInputCols(["document"])
        .setOutputCol("sentences")
    )

    tokenizer = (
        Tokenizer()
        .setInputCols(["sentences"])
        .setOutputCol("tokens")
    )

    normalizer = (
        Normalizer()
        .setInputCols(["tokens"])
        .setOutputCol("normalized")
        .setLowercase(True)
    )

    lemmatizer = (
        LemmatizerModel.pretrained("lemma_gsd", "fr")
        .setInputCols(["normalized"])
        .setOutputCol("lemmas")
    )

    finisher = (
        Finisher()
        .setInputCols(["sentences", "normalized", "lemmas"])
        .setOutputCols(["sentences", "normalized", "lemmas"])
    )

    pipeline = Pipeline(
        stages=[
            document,
            sentence_detector,
            tokenizer,
            normalizer,
            lemmatizer,
            finisher
        ]
    )

    result = pipeline.fit(library).transform(library)
else:
    result = spark.read.parquet(str(annotation_cache))

result = result.repartition(16, "id").persist()

if do_annotation: result.write.parquet(str(annotation_cache))
```
